sources.snippet:
# The maximum amount of a fine under UK GDPR and DPA 2018
20. Article 83 UK GDPR and section 157 DPA 2018 provide for two levels of maximum fine, depending on the statutory provision that has been infringed. These are referred to as the ‘standard maximum amount’ and the ‘higher maximum amount’. The tables in Annex 2 set out which level of maximum fine applies to the relevant provisions of the UK GDPR and DPA 2018, as set out in Article 83(4) and (5) UK GDPR and section 157(2), (3) and (4) DPA 2018.
